identity_description: Native string groupId; leading zeros and long digit strings are retained.
limitations: GET query https://ifundcontrolprodops.alipay.com/api/fundOut/costCutFlow/query with only fixed pageNo=0/pageSize=1000; one unfiltered request, no guessed pagination or detail queries.
Boolean success true, data.businessDataList, exact integer pageNo/pageSize and nonnegative integer totalCount/totalPageNo required. Native totalPageNo=0 is a placeholder, never completeness proof.

1000 is the qualified fixed width, not a measured maximum. SDK checks native total, unique identities and capacity. Duplicate/conflicting/truncated responses remain incomplete and cannot publish on refresh.

Exact local matching: repeated same-field values OR, different fields AND; scalar whole-string or declared string-array member only. Missing/null do not match; no comma splitting, substring, wildcard, trimming or boolean coercion.

Full native rows and unknown/nested values, precise amounts, nulls, zero, empty strings and array order are retained. Displayed root rows sort lexically by native string identity; timestamp units/timezone are unverified.
Live never publishes. Only complete nonempty refresh publishes; failed, empty or incomplete refresh preserves the saved capture. No Get, rule execution or new Duckdog import.
Cost-reduction records are group summaries, not full historical rule versions or realized savings. Native ratio/ratioBase scaling is unverified.

sync.evidence: Native string groupId; leading zeros and long digit strings are retained. Complete acquisition uses the declared native List collector and its scope/completeness evidence.
